system.description:
A good-luck token, keepsake or holy relic meant to earn the favor of the gods, from saintly bones to blessed bolter casings. True relics are nearly impossible to tell from fakes.

A charm grants no mechanical bonus, but when the story calls for misfortune to strike a random character, the SM may spare one who carries a charm; if everyone has one, the SM decides whose is strongest.
system.effectText: Luck token; no mechanical bonus, but SM may spare the bearer from random misfortune.
